A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Useful answers.

Does 100+ countries mean every address is covered?+

No. Service availability can depend on the exact postcode, item and selected carrier. The team should confirm coverage for your shipment.

What does the network map show?+

The map illustrates selected international destinations from our service network. Contact the team to confirm the available options for your exact destination and postcode.

My destination is not shown. Can I still enquire?+

Yes. The six countries shown are just a starting point. Tell us where your family, friends or customers are and we’ll check the options.
